suggestions.title: The torn corner
suggestions.premise: Mara spreads her torn map across a crate on the Saltmarch docks and asks for help matching the missing corner. Whatever it marks has to be found before the coronation closes the harbour.

suggestions.title: A ledger in the wrong hands
suggestions.premise: Seraphine Vale hears that the harbour ledger changed hands last night. With the coronation ten days off, whoever holds it can buy a seat at the ceremony.

suggestions.title: Salt and quiet
suggestions.premise: A slack evening on the waterfront, with Seraphine and Mara sharing a bottle and nothing urgent between them. It is the last calm night before the city fills for the coronation.
